album: New Music This Week: JustJaewin, Girls Like Mystery, Charlie Lim, Ruth Kueo, teem, Chelsea Cara, AARCADE & more
excerpt: Every week, many local musicians release new music that flies under the radar. This week, we have a bumper crop and to bring you the best new music releases from home, we've compiled a playlist featuring some of the newest songs out from artists such as JustJaewin, Girls Like Mystery, Charlie Lim, Ruth Kueo, teem, Chelsea Cara, AARCADE, TheVighnaLisa, JOELLE and Hui Xin.
